summary: Tested iter20 security PR: 5 unauth 401 guards on offline-invoice admin endpoints, super_admin dry_run, find-duplicates route de-shadowing, PUT /invoices/offline/{id} GST recompute, product-page/by-slug regression, and StoreInvoiceCleanup UI flow. 11/12 backend tests passing; 1 real bug surfaced in document-numbering preview.

minor.issue: HRBR store returns preview 'HRBR0002/25-26' which already exists in offline_invoices (collision). Root cause: HRBR's numbering config has use_custom_format=true with custom_format='HRBR0002/25-26' — a LITERAL string with no {sequence} placeholder. format_document_number therefore returns the same value for every sequence value, and find_next_free_sequence detects it as a static format (line 302-303) and bails out without healing. The atomic $inc allocation fix in get_next_document_number IS correct on its own; the bug is that the custom_format for HRBR was persisted as a literal (probably data seed / UI let user save a value without a {sequence} placeholder). Same risk exists for any other store whose custom_format lacks the sequence token.

action_items: Validate/repair document_numbering.document_configs for HRBR (and any other store) so custom_format either includes a {sequence} placeholder or is disabled (use_custom_format=false). Add server-side validation in the numbering-config PUT endpoint that rejects use_custom_format=true when the format has no {sequence} token, to prevent this class of collision going forward.
Consider surfacing a warning in preview response when the detected format is static (would collide with existing docs).
critical_code_review_comments: verify_admin/verify_super_admin correctly wired on the 5 targeted routes — all return 401 without a bearer token as designed.

get_next_document_number in document_numbering_routes.py uses find_one_and_update with $inc for atomic sequence allocation — correct fix for the previously reported race. Loop up to 2000 iterations to skip already-existing numbers is defensive.

Static-format guard in find_next_free_sequence (line 302) bails silently without any signal — it should probably return an is_static flag so callers can warn users; today it happily returns a colliding number.
StoreDeleteRequest.confirm mechanism (DELETE-<code>) is a sane safety net; delete-by-store dry_run correctly returns {status,dry_run,matched} without mutating data.
EditInvoiceRequest requires edited_by (non-optional); frontend StoreDocumentManager must supply it (verified schema requirement).

See backend_issues.minor for details.
rca of the issue: Numbering collision RCA: db.document_numbering entry for HRBR has document_configs.invoice.use_custom_format=true and custom_format='HRBR0002/25-26' (a literal, no sequence token). format_document_number returns the literal regardless of the sequence integer, so find_next_free_sequence detects a static format (line 302) and immediately returns the existing invoice_number without advancing. Mitigation: either (a) update HRBR config to use_custom_format=false OR set custom_format='HRBR{sequence:04d}/25-26' with a placeholder; and (b) add PUT validation on /api/document-numbering config to reject custom_format lacking a sequence placeholder when use_custom_format=true. Reproduction: GET /api/document-numbering/preview/ade28bcc-5da5-4895-8d20-9303ce713d32/invoice returns HRBR0002/25-26; GET /api/invoices/offline?store_id=... shows that same invoice_number already exists.
